replies.question: I need to make a corrective action for msb
replies.content:
I can create a **Corrective Action Form** for **msb**.

**You haven't told me what happened yet**, so I can't cite the policy manual — the draft will come back without the policy section and page. You can create it now and fill it in yourself, or tell me here what happened and I'll draft it (or redraft the form you created) with the manual's section and page cited.

**Store:** Omaha, NE (West Dodge Rd), your assigned store — tell me if that should change

Is this new corrective action a **Verbal Warning** or a **Written Warning**? Tell me here, or tick it on the form — I won't choose it for you.

You'll set any prior coaching or corrective action on the form — I won't guess at it.

One more question: **Is payroll deduct applicable?** Yes or No? Tell me here, or tick it on the form — I won't answer it for you.

**Action plan:** Management will review the applicable company policy with Msb. Future policy violations may result in additional corrective action up to and including termination of employment.

What is **msb**'s position (job title)? I don't have one from Woven or from what you've told me. Tell me here, or fill in Job Title on the form — I won't guess it.

Create the draft here when you're ready, and edit it below — nothing is saved to anyone's file until you do.
